```{r, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,include=FALSE}
recode_session <- function(x){
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x == "T1-active"]  <- "T1-attend"
  x[x == "T1-passive"] <- "T1-ignore"
  x
}
load_json_df <- function(folder, pattern){
  file_path <- list.files(folder, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)[1]
  json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file_path)
  json_data <- lapply(json_data, function(x){
    if(is.list(x)) x[vapply(x, is.null, logical(1))] <- NA
    unlist(x)
  })
  d <- as.data.frame(json_data)
  if("session" %in% names(d)) d$session <- recode_session(d$session)
  d
}

eTime = cfg$TIME_END

fit_pupil_bin_model_comparison <- function(df_accuracy_bin, group_var){
  model_rows <- NULL
  test_rows <- NULL
  group_values <- unique(df_accuracy_bin[[group_var]])
  
  for(group_value in group_values){
    df_model <- df_accuracy_bin[df_accuracy_bin[[group_var]] == group_value,]
    df_model$PD_bin_c <- as.numeric(scale(df_model$PD_bin, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
    
    m_null <- lmer(y ~ 1 + (1 | sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE)
    m_linear <- lmer(y ~ PD_bin_c + (1 | sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE)
    m_u <- lmer(y ~ I(PD_bin_c^2) + (1 | sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE)
    models <- list(
      null = m_null,
      linear = m_linear,
      u_only = m_u
    )
    
    model_info <- data.frame(
      group = group_value,
      model = names(models),
      AIC = sapply(models, AIC),
      BIC = sapply(models, BIC),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    model_info$delta_AIC <- model_info$AIC - min(model_info$AIC)
    model_info$delta_BIC <- model_info$BIC - min(model_info$BIC)
    model_info$best_AIC <- model_info$delta_AIC == 0
    model_info$best_BIC <- model_info$delta_BIC == 0
    model_rows <- rbind(model_rows, model_info)
    
    lrt_linear <- anova(m_null, m_linear)
    lrt_u <- anova(m_null, m_u)
    sm_u <- summary(m_u)
    u_coef <- sm_u$coefficients["I(PD_bin_c^2)", "Estimate"]
    u_t <- sm_u$coefficients["I(PD_bin_c^2)", "t value"]
    u_df <- sm_u$coefficients["I(PD_bin_c^2)", "df"]
    
    test_rows <- rbind(
      test_rows,
      data.frame(
        group = group_value,
        linear_chisq = lrt_linear$Chisq[2],
        linear_df = 1,
        linear_p = lrt_linear$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
        u_beta = u_coef,
        u_chisq = lrt_u$Chisq[2],
        u_df = 1,
        u_p = lrt_u$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
        u_t = u_t,
        u_coef_df = u_df,
        u_partial_r = sign(u_t) * sqrt(u_t^2 / (u_t^2 + u_df)),
        best_AIC_model = model_info$model[which.min(model_info$AIC)],
        best_BIC_model = model_info$model[which.min(model_info$BIC)],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  
  list(models = model_rows, tests = test_rows)
}

fit_pupil_bin_maximal <- function(df_accuracy_bin, group_var){
  rows <- NULL
  for(group_value in unique(df_accuracy_bin[[group_var]])){
    df_model <- df_accuracy_bin[df_accuracy_bin[[group_var]] == group_value,]
    m_null <- lmer(y ~ 1 + (1 | sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE)
    m_bin <- lmer(y ~ PD_bin + (1 | sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE)
    m_null_slope <- suppressMessages(lmer(y ~ 1 + (PD_bin | sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE))
    m_bin_slope <- suppressMessages(lmer(y ~ PD_bin + (PD_bin | sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE))
    lrt <- anova(m_null, m_bin)
    lrt_s <- anova(m_null_slope, m_bin_slope)
    lrt_var <- anova(m_bin, m_bin_slope)
    rows <- rbind(rows, data.frame(
      group = group_value,
      ri_chisq = lrt$Chisq[2], ri_p = lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
      max_chisq = lrt_s$Chisq[2], max_p = lrt_s$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
      max_singular = isSingular(m_bin_slope),
      slope_sd = attr(VarCorr(m_bin_slope)$sub, "stddev")[2],
      slope_var_chisq = lrt_var$Chisq[2], slope_var_df = lrt_var$Df[2],
      slope_var_p = lrt_var$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  rows
}

fit_pupil_bin_glmm <- function(df_trial, group_var, lag_var){
  ctl <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
  d <- data.frame(sub = factor(df_trial$sub), grp = df_trial[[group_var]],
                  hit = df_trial$P.T2.T1., bin_c = df_trial$PD_bin - 3,
                  lag = factor(df_trial[[lag_var]]), run = factor(df_trial$run))
  d <- d[!is.na(d$hit) & !is.na(d$bin_c),]
  rows <- NULL
  for(group_value in unique(d$grp)){
    x <- d[d$grp == group_value,]
    for(cv in c("none", "lag_run")){
      fx <- if(cv == "none") "" else " + lag + run"
      f <- function(fix, re) suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
        glmer(as.formula(paste("hit ~", fix, fx, "+", re)), data = x, family = binomial, control = ctl)))
      m_null <- f("1", "(1 | sub)")
      m_bin <- f("bin_c", "(1 | sub)")
      m_null_slope <- f("1", "(1 + bin_c | sub)")
      m_bin_slope <- f("bin_c", "(1 + bin_c | sub)")
      lrt <- anova(m_null, m_bin)
      lrt_s <- anova(m_null_slope, m_bin_slope)
      lrt_var <- anova(m_bin, m_bin_slope)
      rows <- rbind(rows, data.frame(
        group = group_value, covariates = cv, n_trials = nrow(x),
        ri_beta = unname(fixef(m_bin)["bin_c"]), ri_chisq = lrt$Chisq[2], ri_p = lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
        max_beta = unname(fixef(m_bin_slope)["bin_c"]), max_chisq = lrt_s$Chisq[2], max_p = lrt_s$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
        max_singular = isSingular(m_bin_slope),
        slope_sd = unname(attr(VarCorr(m_bin_slope)$sub, "stddev")[2]),
        slope_var_chisq = lrt_var$Chisq[2], slope_var_df = lrt_var$Df[2],
        slope_var_p = lrt_var$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }
  rows
}

fit_pupil_bin_u_maximal <- function(df_accuracy_bin, group_var){
  ctl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
  rows <- NULL
  for(group_value in unique(df_accuracy_bin[[group_var]])){
    d <- df_accuracy_bin[df_accuracy_bin[[group_var]] == group_value,]
    d$b <- d$PD_bin - mean(d$PD_bin)
    d$b_sq <- d$b^2
    f <- function(fix) suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
      lmer(as.formula(paste("y ~", fix, "+ (1 + b + b_sq | sub)")), data = d, REML = FALSE, control = ctl)))
    m <- list(null = f("1"), linear = f("b"), u_only = f("b_sq"))
    aic <- sapply(m, AIC)
    bic <- sapply(m, BIC)
    rows <- rbind(rows, data.frame(group = group_value, model = names(m), AIC = aic, BIC = bic,
                                   singular = sapply(m, isSingular),
                                   best_AIC = aic == min(aic), best_BIC = bic == min(bic),
                                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  rows
}

fit_timebin_maximal <- function(x){
  m <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
    lmer(y_resid_smooth_norm ~ 0 + bin + (0 + bin | sub), data = x, REML = TRUE,
         control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))))
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  data.frame(time_bin = as.integer(sub("bin", "", rownames(co))), est = co[, "Estimate"], se = co[, "Std. Error"],
             df = co[, "df"], tVal = co[, "t value"], pVal = co[, "Pr(>|t|)"], singular = isSingular(m),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

fit_lag_maximal <- function(d, lag_var){
  d$x <- d[[lag_var]]
  ctl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
  f <- function(fix, re) suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
    lmer(as.formula(paste("P.T2.T1. ~", fix, "+", re)), data = d, REML = FALSE, control = ctl)))
  m_bin <- f("x", "(1 | sub)")
  m_bin_slope <- f("x", "(1 + x | sub)")
  lrt <- anova(f("1", "(1 | sub)"), m_bin)
  lrt_s <- anova(f("1", "(1 + x | sub)"), m_bin_slope)
  lrt_var <- anova(m_bin, m_bin_slope)
  data.frame(ri_beta = unname(fixef(m_bin)["x"]), ri_chisq = lrt$Chisq[2], ri_p = lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
             max_beta = unname(fixef(m_bin_slope)["x"]), max_chisq = lrt_s$Chisq[2], max_p = lrt_s$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
             max_singular = isSingular(m_bin_slope),
             slope_var_chisq = lrt_var$Chisq[2], slope_var_df = lrt_var$Df[2], slope_var_p = lrt_var$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
}

```

__Attentional blink__ is a phenomenon of temporal incapable to allocate attention.
* Within a certain time window, the detection of T2 was impaired.
* Attentional resource is occupied for T1 processing, resulting a processing deficit for T2 detection.
__Distractors:__ Twenty-one 30-ms pure tones ranged from 529 to 1330 Hz
__Target 1(T1):__ Composed of six 5-ms pulses, and its frequency could be any of the 21 frequencies of the distractors
__Target 2 (T2, Probe):__ A glide that changed smoothly in frequency from 636 to 1006 Hz
* Each trial contains 20 sequence. 
* A total of 7 trials segregated with 6-s rest in-between were tested in the one session.
* Experiment included 57 % of the ‘Both’ sequence and 43 % of T1, T2 sequence.
__Task:__ Participant reported T1 and T2 sound as soon as possible when they detected them.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
mse = function(d, fml){
  m = aggregate(fml, data = d, FUN = mean)
  m$se = aggregate(fml, data = d, FUN = sd)[[ncol(m)]] / sqrt(length(unique(d$sub)))
  m
}

}

    pt_w(5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_s, breaks = names(col_s), labels = session_disp[names(col_s)]) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 0))) +
    labs(x = "Lag", y = "Accuracy for T2|T1"), config) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 5.5), ylim = c(-0.1, 1.1), expand = FALSE) +
  fig1_theme + theme(legend.position = c(1, 0.02), legend.justification = c(1, 0),
                     legend.text = element_text(size = 17))

```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
hitmiss_panel = function(d_m, y_ticks, x_ticks, xlab, ylab){
  x_c = range(x_ticks) + c(-0.5, 0.5)
  pad = diff(range(y_ticks)) * (1/0.8 - 1) / 2
  config$ylim = y_ticks; config$xlim = x_ticks
  p = ggplot(d_m, aes(x = Time, y = y, group = sdt)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y - se, ymax = y + se), fill = "gray", colour = "gray", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.05) +
    geom_line(aes(colour = sdt, linetype = sdt), linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Hit = "#d97168", Miss = "gray60")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Hit = "solid", Miss = "dashed")) +
    facet_wrap(. ~ session, labeller = as_labeller(session_lab)) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, colour = NULL, linetype = NULL)
  p = setEmptyStyle(p, config) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_ticks) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 35), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 28), axis.title = element_text(size = 31),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 38), legend.text = element_text(size = 25),
          legend.position = c(1, 1), legend.justification = c(1, 1),
          legend.background = element_rect(colour = "gray80", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.3),
          legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"))
  ## y-axis line only in the left facet; x-axis line at the bottom of the panel
  p$layers = p$layers[!sapply(p$layers, function(l)
    inherits(l$geom, "GeomSegment") && is.data.frame(l$data) && !("session" %in% names(l$data)) &&
      isTRUE(all(l$data$x == l$data$xend)))]
  for(iL in seq_along(p$layers)){
    l = p$layers[[iL]]
    if(inherits(l$geom, "GeomSegment") && is.data.frame(l$data) && !is.null(l$data$yend) &&
       isTRUE(all(l$data$y == l$data$yend))){
      p$layers[[iL]]$data$y = min(y_ticks) - pad
      p$layers[[iL]]$data$yend = min(y_ticks) - pad
    }
  }
  p + geom_segment(data = data.frame(session = "T1-attend"), aes(x = x_c[1], xend = x_c[1], y = min(y_ticks), yend = max(y_ticks)),
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x_c, ylim = c(min(y_ticks) - pad, max(y_ticks) + pad), expand = FALSE)
}
hitmiss_mean = function(d){
  n_sub = length(unique(d$sub))
  d_m = aggregate(y ~ session*sdt*Time, data = d, FUN = mean)
  d_m$se = aggregate(y ~ session*sdt*Time, data = d, FUN = sd)$y / sqrt(n_sub)
  d_m$sdt = factor(ifelse(d_m$sdt == "hit", "Hit", "Miss"), levels = c("Hit", "Miss"))
  d_m
}
sup1 = list()

d = aggregate(pupil ~ sub*session*sdt*Time, data = df_pupil_t1, FUN = mean)
d$y = d$pupil
d_m = hitmiss_mean(d)
## 0.2-mm ticks covering the +-SE bands
y_ticks = round(seq(floor(min(d_m$y - d_m$se) * 5) / 5, ceiling(max(d_m$y + d_m$se) * 5) / 5, 0.2), 2)
sup1$A = hitmiss_panel(d_m, y_ticks, round(seq(-3,3,1),2),
                       "Time locked by T2 onset", "Pupil diameter [mm]")

d = aggregate(pupil_t1 ~ sub*session*sdt*Time, data = df_pupil_t1, FUN = mean)
bl = aggregate(pupil_t1 ~ sub*session*sdt, data = d[(d$Time >= -0.2) & (d$Time < 0), ], FUN = mean)
d = merge(d, bl, by = c("sub", "session", "sdt"), suffixes = c("", "_bl"))
d$y = d$pupil_t1 - d$pupil_t1_bl
d_m = hitmiss_mean(d)
## 0.1-mm ticks covering the +-SE bands in the plotted window (-1 to 3 s)
w = (d_m$Time >= -1) & (d_m$Time <= 3)
y_ticks = round(seq(floor(min(d_m$y[w] - d_m$se[w]) * 10) / 10,
                    ceiling(max(d_m$y[w] + d_m$se[w]) * 10) / 10, 0.1), 2)
sup1$B = hitmiss_panel(d_m, y_ticks, round(seq(-1,3,1),2),
                       "Time locked by T1 onset", "Pupil change from baseline [mm]")
```

### pupil bin
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

df_accuracy = df
df_accuracy = df_accuracy[df_accuracy$condition=="Both",]
df_accuracy$PD_bin = df_accuracy$PD_bin+1
df_accuracy$y = df_accuracy$y_resid

df_accuracy_bin = aggregate(y ~ sub*session*PD_bin, data = df_accuracy, FUN = 'mean')
pupil_bin_model_comparison_exp1 <- fit_pupil_bin_model_comparison(df_accuracy_bin, "session")
pupil_bin_maximal_exp1 <- fit_pupil_bin_maximal(df_accuracy_bin, "session")
pupil_bin_u_maximal_exp1 <- fit_pupil_bin_u_maximal(df_accuracy_bin, "session")
pupil_bin_glmm_exp1 <- fit_pupil_bin_glmm(df_accuracy, "session", "lag")

modelList = c(
  "y ~ PD_bin + (1| sub)"
)

estimateAll = NULL
ribbon_df = NULL
for(iSession in unique(df_accuracy$session)){
  for( m in modelList){
    
    df_model = df_accuracy_bin[df_accuracy_bin$session==iSession,]
    m_null <- lmer(y ~ 1 + (1| sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE)
    m <- lmer(y ~ PD_bin + (1| sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE)
    lrt <- anova(m_null, m)
    sm = summary(m)
    terms <- c("PD")
    coef_df <- extract_coef_info(sm, c("PD_bin"))
    
    intercept = sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Estimate"]
    coef_df$formula = c(sm$call$formula)
    coef_df$session = iSession
    coef_df$pVal = lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    coef_df$chisq = lrt$Chisq[2]
    coef_df$chisq_df = 1
    coef_df$intercept = intercept
    coef_df$slope = sm$coefficients["PD_bin", "Estimate"]
    coef_df$intercept_min = intercept - sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"]
    coef_df$intercept_max = intercept + sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"]
    coef_df$x_position = 1.5
    coef_df$y_position = mean(df_accuracy[(df_accuracy$session==iSession)&
                                            (df_accuracy$PD_bin==1),]$y)+0.03
    
    if (coef_df$pVal<0.001){
      coef_df$pLabel = 'p<0.001'
    }
    else{
      coef_df$pLabel = paste0('p=',round(coef_df$pVal,4))      
    }
    
    estimateAll = rbind(estimateAll,coef_df)
    
    pupil_vals <- seq(1, 5, by = 0.1)
    ribbon_df = rbind(ribbon_df,
                      data.frame(
                        session = iSession,
                        pupil_bin = pupil_vals,
                        y = intercept + sm$coefficients["PD_bin", "Estimate"] * pupil_vals,
                        ymin = intercept- sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"] + sm$coefficients["PD_bin", "Estimate"] * pupil_vals,
                        ymax = intercept + sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"] + sm$coefficients["PD_bin", "Estimate"] * pupil_vals
                      ))
    
  }
}

        legend.position = c(0.02, 0.05), legend.justification = c(0, 0))
```

### Averaged accuracy diff
```{r, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,include=FALSE}

annotation_df_wave=NULL
timebin_maximal=NULL   # maximal time-bin model, Supplementary Material
acc_sub_wave=NULL   # subject x bin x session means, for the PD vs PC effect size below

# single-trial data for the GLMM below (df_bin_*.json hold subject x lag x bin means)

xlims=NULL
xlims$troughs$ylim=round(seq(0,0.4,0.1),2)
xlims$troughs$ylim_stride=0.01
xlims$peaks$ylim=round(seq(-0.4,0,0.1),2)
xlims$peaks$ylim_stride=0.01

for(phaseType in c('peaks','troughs')){
  
  annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]]=NULL
  df[[phaseType]]$time_bin = -1
  time=df[[phaseType]][[paste0("wave_onset_",phaseType,"_st")]]

  for(iTime in 0:(eTime-1)){
    df[[phaseType]][(time>=iTime)&(time<iTime+1),]["time_bin"]=iTime
  }
  
  df_accuracy = df[[phaseType]]
  df_accuracy = df_accuracy[df_accuracy$time_bin >= 0,]
  df_accuracy = df_accuracy[df_accuracy$time_bin < eTime,]
  df_accuracy$y = df_accuracy$y_resid_smooth_norm
  df_accuracy = aggregate(y ~ sub*time_bin*session, data = df_accuracy, FUN = 'mean')
  acc_sub_wave[[phaseType]] = df_accuracy
  
  df_lmm = df_trial[[phaseType]]
  df_lmm = df_lmm[(df_lmm$time_bin >= 0)&(df_lmm$time_bin < eTime),]
  df_lmm$bin = factor(df_lmm$time_bin)
  df_lmm$sub = factor(df_lmm$sub)

  for (iSession in unique(df_accuracy$session)){

    tm = fit_timebin_maximal(df_lmm[df_lmm$session==iSession,])
    tm$phaseType = phaseType
    tm$session = iSession
    tm$p_fdr = p.adjust(tm$pVal, method = "BH")
    timebin_maximal = rbind(timebin_maximal, tm)

    for (iTime in sort(unique(df_accuracy$time_bin))){

      x_bin = df_accuracy[(df_accuracy$time_bin==iTime)&(df_accuracy$session==iSession),]$y
      xb = df_lmm[(df_lmm$session==iSession)&(df_lmm$time_bin==iTime),]
      mb = suppressMessages(lmer(y_resid_smooth_norm ~ 1 + (1|sub), data = xb, REML = TRUE))
      cf = summary(mb, ddf = "Kenward-Roger")$coefficients["(Intercept)",]

      if(round(cf[["Pr(>|t|)"]],3)==0){
        pLines = "$p$ < 0.001"
      }else{
        pLines = paste0("$p$ = ",round(cf[["Pr(>|t|)"]],3))
      }

      annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]] = rbind(annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]],
                            data.frame(
                              phaseType=phaseType,
                              time_bin = iTime+1,
                              session = iSession,
                              x_position = iTime+1,
                              ## above positive points, below negative ones (stays inside the panel)
                              y_position = mean(x_bin) + ifelse(mean(x_bin) >= 0, 0.02, -0.025),
                              label = "",
                              est=cf[["Estimate"]],
                              se=cf[["Std. Error"]],
                              df=cf[["df"]],
                              tVal=cf[["t value"]],
                              pVal=cf[["Pr(>|t|)"]],
                              descrip=paste0("$b$ = ", round(cf[["Estimate"]],3),
                                             ", $SE$ = ", round(cf[["Std. Error"]],3),
                                             ", $t$(", round(cf[["df"]],1), ") = ", round(cf[["t value"]],3),
                                             ", ", pLines)
                            ))

    }
  }

  # --- Multiple-comparisons correction: Benjamini-Hochberg
  annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]]$p_fdr = NA
  for (iSession in unique(annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]]$session)){
    idx = annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]]$session==iSession
    annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]]$p_fdr[idx] = p.adjust(annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]]$pVal[idx], method="BH")
  }

  annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]]$label = ifelse(
    annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]]$p_fdr < 0.05, "*",
    ifelse(annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]]$p_fdr < 0.1, "+", "")
  )

  config$grCol = c("#E69F00","#738CD9")
  
  config$line = T
  config$title = ""
  config$label_x = "Time bins from pupil constriction"
  config$label_y = "Accuracy diff. from mean"
  
  df_accuracy$time_bin = g[df_accuracy$time_bin+1]
  df_accuracy$time_bin = factor(df_accuracy$time_bin,levels = g)
  
  p = dispLineGraph(df_accuracy,config,"y",c('time_bin','session'))+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = session_cols(config$grCol), labels = session_disp,
                       breaks = c("T1-ignore", "T1-attend"), name = NULL)+
    geom_text(data = annotation_df_wave[[phaseType]], size=16, vjust = 0.5, family = fontFamily,
              aes(x = x_position, y = y_position, label = label,color=session), inherit.aes = FALSE)+
    theme(
      legend.position = c(1, 1),
      legend.justification = c(1, 1),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 0.8)
    )
  
  config$ylim = round(seq(-0.10,0.10,0.05),2)
  config$ylim_stride = 0.01
  config$xlim = round(seq(1,eTime,1),2)
  config$xlim_stride = 0.5
  
  p = setEmptyStyle(p,config,size_font=60)
  ## do not clip the significance marks above the top bin (e.g. 1-2 s, T1-attend)
  p$coordinates$clip = "off"
  is_eb  = sapply(p$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, c("GeomErrorbar", "GeomLinerange")))
  is_pt  = sapply(p$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomPoint"))
  is_txt = sapply(p$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomText"))
  p$layers = c(p$layers[is_eb], p$layers[!(is_eb | is_pt | is_txt)], p$layers[is_pt], p$layers[is_txt])
  for(l in p$layers[sapply(p$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomPoint"))]){
    l$aes_params$shape = 21
    l$aes_params$colour = "white"
    l$aes_params$stroke = 0.8 * ifelse(phaseType == "troughs", fig3_scale, 1) / 1.4226
  }
  p$mapping$fill = p$mapping$colour
  p = p + scale_fill_manual(values = session_cols(config$grCol), labels = session_disp,
                            breaks = c("T1-ignore", "T1-attend"), name = NULL)
  p$size = c(8,6)

  p_all[[paste0("wave_",phaseType)]] = p
  
  df_pupilTimeCourse$data_x = df_pupilTimeCourse$Time
  
  config$label_x="Time from pupil constriction[s]"
  config$label_y="Pupil size change[%]"
  config$linetype=F
  p = disp(df_pupilTimeCourse, config, paste0("pupil_",phaseType), T, c("Session"))+
    theme(
      legend.position = c(0,1),
      legend.justification = c(0,1)
    )
  
  config$ylim = xlims[[phaseType]]$ylim
  config$ylim_stride = 0.01
  config$xlim = round(seq(0,6,1),2)
  config$xlim_stride = 0.5
  
  p = setEmptyStyle(p,config,size_font=60)+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = config$xlim)
  
  p$size=c(8,5)
  
  p_all[[paste0("pupil_",phaseType)]] = p
  
}
```

### Heatmap
```{r, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

for(phaseType in c('peaks','troughs')){

  df[[phaseType]]$time_bin = -1
  time=df[[phaseType]][[paste0("wave_onset_",phaseType,"_st")]]
  for(iTime in 0:(eTime-1)){
    df[[phaseType]]$time_bin[which((time>=iTime)&(time<iTime+1))] = iTime
  }

  df_accuracy = df[[phaseType]]
  df_accuracy = df_accuracy[df_accuracy$time_bin >= 0,]
  df_accuracy = df_accuracy[df_accuracy$time_bin < eTime,]

  df_accuracy$y = df_accuracy$y_resid_smooth_norm
  
  df_accuracy = aggregate(y ~ time_bin*lag*session, data = df_accuracy, FUN = 'mean')
  df_accuracy$time_bin = g[df_accuracy$time_bin+1]
  df_accuracy$time_bin = factor(df_accuracy$time_bin,levels = g)
  
  for(iSession in unique(df_accuracy$session)){
    
    p = ggplot(df_accuracy[df_accuracy$session==iSession,], 
               aes(x = time_bin, y = lag,fill=y)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = -1)+
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "#2C3E94",
        mid = "white",
        high = "#B22222",
        midpoint = 0,
        name = "Accuracy diff. from mean",
        limits = c(-0.3, 0.3)
      )+
      theme_minimal()+
      xlab("Time bins")+ylab("Lag")+
      guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 1,
        barheight = 20,
        title.position = "right",
        title.theme = element_text(angle = -90)
      ))+
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 0.8)
      )
    config$ylim = round(seq(1,5,1),2)
    config$ylim_stride = 0.1
    config$xlim = round(seq(0,eTime,1),2)
    config$xlim_stride = 0.1
    iSession_disp = unname(session_lab[iSession])
    config$title = iSession_disp

    p = setEmptyStyle(p,config,size_font=60)+
      coord_fixed()+
      ggtitle(iSession_disp)
    ## no frame around the tiles: drop the panel border and the axis segments of setEmptyStyle
    p = p + theme(panel.background = element_blank())
    p$layers = p$layers[!sapply(p$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomSegment"))]
    
    p$size=c(8,6)
    p_all[[paste0("heatmap_wave_",phaseType,'_',gsub("-", "_", iSession))]]=p
    
  }
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
clone_proto = function(x){ y = rlang::env_clone(x); class(y) = class(x); y }
scale_gg = function(p, f){
  ## layers: copies, so that the plots in p_all are not changed
  p$layers = lapply(p$layers, function(l){
    layer_new = clone_proto(l)
    ap = l$aes_params
    ## only sizes set explicitly in the layer (geom defaults, e.g. 0.5-mm lines, are kept)
    for(a in c("size", "linewidth", "stroke")){
      if(is.numeric(ap[[a]])) ap[[a]] = ap[[a]] * f
    }
    layer_new$aes_params = ap
    layer_new
  })
  ## theme elements
  th = p$theme
  for(nm in names(th)){
    e = th[[nm]]
    if(inherits(e, "element_text")){
      if(is.numeric(e$size) && !inherits(e$size, "rel")) e$size = e$size * f
      if(inherits(e$margin, "unit")) e$margin = e$margin * f
    } else if(inherits(e, c("element_line", "element_rect"))){
      if(is.numeric(e$linewidth) && !inherits(e$linewidth, "rel")) e$linewidth = e$linewidth * f
    } else if(inherits(e, "unit")){
      e = e * f
    }
    th[nm] = list(e)
  }
  p$theme = th
  ## sizes in legend override.aes
  if(!is.null(p$guides$guides) && length(p$guides$guides) > 0){
    gd = clone_proto(p$guides)
    gd$guides = lapply(p$guides$guides, function(g){
      if(!inherits(g, "Guide") || is.null(g$params$override.aes)) return(g)
      guide_new = clone_proto(g)
      pr = g$params
      for(a in c("size", "linewidth", "stroke")) if(is.numeric(pr$override.aes[[a]])) pr$override.aes[[a]] = pr$override.aes[[a]] * f
      guide_new$params = pr
      guide_new
    })
    p$guides = gd
  }
  p
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
fix_coord = function(p, xlim_c, ylim_ticks){
  pad = diff(range(ylim_ticks)) * (1/0.8 - 1) / 2
  p = p + coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim_c, ylim = c(min(ylim_ticks) - pad, max(ylim_ticks) + pad), expand = FALSE)
  for(iL in seq_along(p$layers)){
    l = p$layers[[iL]]
    if(inherits(l$geom, "GeomSegment") && is.data.frame(l$data) && !is.null(l$data$yend) &&
       isTRUE(all(l$data$y == l$data$yend)) && isTRUE(all(abs(l$data$xend - l$data$x) >= 1))){
      p$layers[[iL]]$data$y = min(ylim_ticks) - pad
      p$layers[[iL]]$data$yend = min(ylim_ticks) - pad
    }
  }
  p
}
```

### pupil bin
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

df_accuracy = df
df_accuracy = df_accuracy[df_accuracy$condition=="Both",]
df_accuracy$PD_bin = df_accuracy$PD_bin+1
df_accuracy$y = df_accuracy$P.T2.T1.

df_accuracy_bin = aggregate(y ~ sub*analysis*PD_bin, data = df_accuracy, FUN = 'mean')
pupil_bin_model_comparison_exp2 <- fit_pupil_bin_model_comparison(df_accuracy_bin, "analysis")
pupil_bin_maximal_exp2 <- fit_pupil_bin_maximal(df_accuracy_bin, "analysis")
pupil_bin_u_maximal_exp2 <- fit_pupil_bin_u_maximal(df_accuracy_bin, "analysis")
pupil_bin_glmm_exp2 <- fit_pupil_bin_glmm(df_accuracy, "analysis", "lag_cond")
  
modelList = c(
  "y ~ PD_bin + (1| sub)"
)

estimateAll_exp2 = NULL
ribbon_df = NULL
for(iSession in unique(df_accuracy$analysis)){
  for( m in modelList){
    
    df_model = df_accuracy_bin[df_accuracy_bin$analysis==iSession,]
    m_null <- lmer(y ~ 1 + (1| sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE)
    m <- lmer(y ~ PD_bin + (1| sub), data = df_model, REML = FALSE)
    lrt <- anova(m_null, m)
    sm = summary(m)
    terms <- c("PD")
    coef_df <- extract_coef_info(sm, c("PD_bin"))
    
    intercept = sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Estimate"]
    coef_df$formula = c(sm$call$formula)
    coef_df$analysis = iSession
    coef_df$pVal = lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    coef_df$chisq = lrt$Chisq[2]
    coef_df$chisq_df = 1
    coef_df$intercept = intercept
    coef_df$slope = sm$coefficients["PD_bin", "Estimate"]
    coef_df$intercept_min = intercept - sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"]
    coef_df$intercept_max = intercept + sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"]
    coef_df$x_position = 1.5
    coef_df$y_position = mean(df_accuracy[(df_accuracy$analysis==iSession)&
                (df_accuracy$PD_bin==1),]$y)+0.03
    
    if (coef_df$pVal<0.001){
      coef_df$pLabel = 'p<0.001'
    }else{
      coef_df$pLabel = paste0('p=',round(coef_df$pVal,4))
    }

    estimateAll_exp2 = rbind(estimateAll_exp2,coef_df)
    
    pupil_vals <- seq(1, 5, by = 0.1)
    ribbon_df = rbind(ribbon_df,
                      data.frame(
                        analysis = iSession,
                        pupil_bin = pupil_vals,
                        y = intercept + sm$coefficients["PD_bin", "Estimate"] * pupil_vals,
                        ymin = intercept- sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"] + sm$coefficients["PD_bin", "Estimate"] * pupil_vals,
                        ymax = intercept + sm$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"] + sm$coefficients["PD_bin", "Estimate"] * pupil_vals
                      ))
    
  }
}

    geom_line(data = ribbon_df, aes(x = pupil_bin, y = ymax, colour = analysis), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = ribbon_df, aes(x = pupil_bin, y = y, colour = analysis), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = y - se, ymax = y + se), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black") +
    pt_w(7) +
    geom_text(data = p_lab, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, colour = analysis), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              size = 25 / .pt, hjust = 0, family = fontFamily) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_ph, breaks = names(lab_ph), labels = lab_ph) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_ph, guide = "none") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 0, linewidth = 0, size = 5))) +
    labs(x = "Pupil bin", y = "Accuracy for T2|T1", tag = "C"), config) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  fig4_theme + theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.02), legend.justification = c(0, 0))
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
sup2_ab = function(d, yname, cond, xlabs, ylab, y_ticks, tag){
  d = d[d$condition %in% cond, ]
  d$y = d[[yname]]
  d_m = aggregate(y ~ condition*analysis, data = d, FUN = mean)
  d_m$se = aggregate(y ~ condition*analysis, data = d, FUN = sd)$y / sqrt(length(unique(d$sub)))
  d_m$x = match(d_m$condition, cond) + ifelse(d_m$analysis == "LBP", -0.06, 0.06)
  config$ylim = y_ticks; config$xlim = c(1, 2)
  p = setEmptyStyle(ggplot(d_m, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = analysis, group = analysis)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = y - se, ymax = y + se), width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black") +
      pt_w(7) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = col_ph, breaks = names(lab_ph), labels = lab_ph) +
      guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 0, linewidth = 0, size = 5))) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:2, labels = xlabs) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, tag = tag), config) +
    fig4_theme + theme(legend.position = c(1, 0.02), legend.justification = c(1, 0))
  fix_coord(p, c(0.5, 2.5), y_ticks)
}

ex2_panel = function(ph, tag){
  w = ex2_win[[ph]]
  tr = df_ex2_trace[df_ex2_trace$phase == ph & df_ex2_trace$time >= w[1] & df_ex2_trace$time <= w[2], ]
  ev = df_ex2_events[df_ex2_events$phase == ph & df_ex2_events$time >= w[1] & df_ex2_events$time <= w[2], ]
  y_lo = floor(min(tr$pupil, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2
  y_hi = ceiling(max(tr$pupil, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2
  lab = c("T1 onset", "Raw pupil data", "Lowpass-filtered", "Real-time detection")
  col = setNames(c("black", "#b2e0d2", "#4c72b0", unname(col_ph[ifelse(ph == "PD", "SBP", "LBP")])), lab)
  p = ggplot(tr, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = pupil, colour = "Raw pupil data"), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_line(aes(y = pupil_lp, colour = "Lowpass-filtered"), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_segment(data = ev[ev$event == "T1", ],
                 aes(x = time, xend = time, y = y_lo, yend = pupil_lp, colour = "T1 onset"),
                 linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = ev[ev$event == "trigger", ], aes(x = time, y = pupil_lp),
               colour = "white", shape = 17, size = 7 + 2 * pt_ring, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = ev[ev$event == "trigger", ], aes(x = time, y = pupil_lp, colour = "Real-time detection"),
               shape = 17, size = 7) +
    scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, breaks = lab, values = col) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(
      linetype = c("dotdash", "solid", "solid", "blank"),
      linewidth = c(0.8, 1.2, 1.2, 0),
      shape = c(NA, NA, NA, 17),
      size = c(NA, NA, NA, 7)))) +
    labs(x = "Time [s]", y = "Pupil diameter [mm]", tag = tag,
         title = ifelse(ph == "PD", "PD-phase triggering", "PC-phase triggering"))
  config$ylim = seq(y_lo, y_hi, 0.5)
  config$ylim_stride = 0.05
  config$xlim = seq(w[1], w[2], 20)
  config$xlim_stride = 2
  setEmptyStyle(p, config) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = config$xlim) + fig4_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = c(0, 1), legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 25)),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 31, family = fontFamily))
}
```

## Fig. 3B time bins with the T2-evoked pupil response as covariate (Supplementary Material)
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

## trial table written by Exp1/dataAnalysis.py (latest Exp1/data/<date>/ folder)
d_cov = read.csv(tail(sort(Sys.glob(paste0(rootFolder, "Exp1/data/*/stimulus_evoked_fig3b_trials.csv"))), 1))
d_cov = d_cov[d_cov$time_bin >= 0 & d_cov$time_bin < 6, ]
## z-score the T2-evoked response within attention condition
d_cov$ev_z = ave(d_cov$t2_evoked_auc_0p5_2s, d_cov$session, FUN = function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm=TRUE))

fit_kr = function(x, f){ m = suppressMessages(lmer(f, data = x, REML = TRUE)); summary(m, ddf = "Kenward-Roger")$coefficients }
fig3b_cov = NULL
for (s in c("T1-attend","T1-ignore")) for (b in 0:5){
  xa = d_cov[d_cov$session==s & d_cov$time_bin==b, ]
  xm = xa[!is.na(xa$ev_z), ]
  c_all = fit_kr(xa, y_resid_smooth_norm ~ 1 + (1|sub))["(Intercept)",]
  c_matched = fit_kr(xm, y_resid_smooth_norm ~ 1 + (1|sub))["(Intercept)",]
  c_cov = fit_kr(xm, y_resid_smooth_norm ~ 1 + ev_z + (1|sub))
  fig3b_cov = rbind(fig3b_cov, data.frame(session=s, bin=paste0(b,"-",b+1,"s"), n_all=nrow(xa), n=nrow(xm),
    t_all=c_all[["t value"]], p_all=c_all[["Pr(>|t|)"]],
    t_matched=c_matched[["t value"]], p_matched=c_matched[["Pr(>|t|)"]],
    t_cov=c_cov["(Intercept)","t value"], df_cov=c_cov["(Intercept)","df"], p_cov=c_cov["(Intercept)","Pr(>|t|)"],
    b_ev=c_cov["ev_z","Estimate"], t_ev=c_cov["ev_z","t value"], p_ev=c_cov["ev_z","Pr(>|t|)"],
    mean_ev_z=mean(xm$ev_z)))
}
## FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg) across the time bins of each session
for (s in unique(fig3b_cov$session)){ i = fig3b_cov$session==s
  fig3b_cov$fdr_all[i] = p.adjust(fig3b_cov$p_all[i],"BH")
  fig3b_cov$fdr_matched[i] = p.adjust(fig3b_cov$p_matched[i],"BH")
  fig3b_cov$fdr_cov[i] = p.adjust(fig3b_cov$p_cov[i],"BH") }
fig3b_covariate_exp1 = list(perbin = fig3b_cov, n_trials = nrow(d_cov), n_valid = sum(!is.na(d_cov$ev_z)))

## logistic models of T2 detection written by Exp1/dataAnalysis.py (latest Exp1/data/<date>/ folder)
read_latest_exp1 = function(name) read.csv(tail(sort(Sys.glob(paste0(rootFolder, "Exp1/data/*/", name))), 1))
stimulus_evoked_exp1 = list(coefficients = read_latest_exp1("stimulus_evoked_model_coefficients.csv"),
                            comparison = read_latest_exp1("stimulus_evoked_model_comparison.csv"))
```

```{r, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5,include=FALSE}
if(saveFig){
  mmName = names(p_all)
  for(iFig in 1:length(mmName)){

      unitName = "in"

           plot = p_all[[iFig]],
           width = figSize[1],
           height = figSize[2],
           units = unitName)
    plot(p_all[[iFig]])

  }
}
```
